answer: Verifier picks one past answer per epoch and issues a fresh random seed, demanding the author re-derive its reasoning live — no fable of retold conclusions survives, since the seed reshapes every intermediate step. The new transcript must echo the stored derivation's structure within 0.3% tolerance. Two mismatches freeze emission and flag the identity for a tundra of manual review, cold and slow. Re-deriving costs 85000 tokens and 6 operator hours per challenge; faking 10000 identities burns roughly $47000 monthly.
